title: Jesus Is Our Good Shepherd! 🐑 John 10 | Bible Story for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Did you know Jesus knows YOUR name? 🐑 In this Bible story for kids, Miss Rania's class plays the Good Shepherd Relay with balloon sheep, and we learn how Jesus, our Good Shepherd, knows each of us, protects us from the wolf, and gave His life so we can be with Him forever. Baa!

📖 Memory verse: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep." (John 10:11)
🎯 Lesson: Jesus is our Good Shepherd. We listen to Him, obey our parents, and trust Him always.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 God Is Our Shepherd

1:11 Jesus gave His life

1:36 How to be good sheep
1:48 Paper plate sheep craft
1:59 Zoe in the dark
2:10 Let's pray
